name: nightbark
description: Finds the tests that did not bark - assertions that cannot fail, fixtures that collide, and detectors that were never able to fire.
author: JJ (Jacob) Badenhorst

scripts.selftest: node bin/nightbark.mjs selftest && node bin/nightbark.mjs selfcheck && node scripts/gen-ci.mjs --check && node --test "test/*.test.mjs"
